question: Which ministry is the nodal ministry for the Bio-RIDE Scheme approved in September 2024?

options.text: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy

solution:
The correct answer is __**Ministry of Science & Technology**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Bio-RIDE Scheme** was approved in **September 2024** to foster innovation and research in the field of biotechnology.
 
• The nodal ministry responsible for this scheme is the **Ministry of Science & Technology**, which oversees the research and development initiatives in scientific and technological areas in India.
 
• This scheme aims to promote **biotechnology-driven research** and innovation, particularly in areas such as healthcare, agriculture, and environmental sustainability.
